title: Composition with security-auth-magic-link: zone rate rule layers over the per-email application rule
asA: operator applying both edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting and security-auth-magic-link on the same project
iWant: the guide to name the ADR-3702 layering explicitly, showing that the zone rule refuses IP-per-URL bursts at the CF edge before they reach the origin and the security-auth-magic-link per-email application rule continues to run on requests that pass the edge gate
soThat: I understand the composition at apply time rather than discovering that both blueprints operate on separate characteristic sets by trial and error

acceptanceCriteria.description: The guide contains a section titled Composition with security-auth-magic-link that names ADR-3702 explicitly, states the zone rule characteristic (IP-per-URL) and the application rule characteristic (per-email per-minute) verbatim, and shows a copy-paste example of both blueprints applied on the same project.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the anatomy test scans the guide for the composition section and ADR-3702 reference
acceptanceCriteria.then: the section heading, ADR-3702 reference, both characteristic strings and the copy-paste example are present

coverageNote: The single AC binds the guide's Composition with security-auth-magic-link section presence assertion; the compositional runtime effects are covered by security-auth-magic-link's own ACs and the guide has no additional failure path for this story, so a single AC is sufficient per section 7a.
